Record notes

Eleven complete writing workflows for clear prose, source-grounded messages, authentic voice, technical instructions and grant work.

Version 0.3.6 includes 11 complete skill procedures. Complete first-party and licensed methods; optional AIHumanizer and Write Like Me provider routes.

Requirements: Agent host with file-reading tools; Python 3.10+ for optional local text helpers; Separate provider access for connected documents and optional publisher methods.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add writing-quality-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 262359f9a82eed13d0a3574854f947115f3fce43. SHA-256: 089b4a54ab388f4adfac37849584de399e06fb097b57f0cbd7a28940b14d4449.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
